integrity: The proof reconstructs the coderivative iterates directly from the strict-successor semantics, proves uniqueness of the finite fixed point, and derives both directions of the truncated-sequence cutoff. The recent primary source was inspected in full text around its coderivative characterization, least-fixed-point formula, free-sequence definition, and nonderivability proof. Targeted literature and indexed-finding searches did not locate the exact finite-height forcing profile.
scientific_limitations: The exact cutoff is proved for the upset algebra of a finite nonempty poset. Infinite posets may require transfinite iteration, and no general dual reformulation for arbitrary finite Heyting algebras is claimed here.
title: Exact height cutoff for finite coderivative sequences
